name: Ding-CC-OT-r1
status: LOSS_KERNEL_TESTED; full detector-stage wrapper/SFD binding remains a required release blocker

classification.initialization: same cached ImageNet features as CES by backbone

SFD.ranking: TRAIN only;512projected channels;lowest batch-mean channel SNNL (no absolute value);n=max(1,round(2%*512));strict mean<sorted[n];ties may yield fewer;no optimizer
SFD.ties_or_degenerate_channels: record actual count/ranks;stop and report if degenerate/inadequate;no replacement/fallback channels

adaptation.sampler: same full label×gender_race quotas as CES;original draws and optimizer steps reported
adaptation.trainable: last_linear Xception or fc ResNet only
adaptation.BN: frozen running statistics and affine except classifier policy
adaptation.seed: use declared seed at every stage;no implicit121
adaptation.conditioning: separate y=0 and y=1 fake-probability empirical distributions;sum the two class terms,mean groups

selection: same validation AUC-only rule and validation-real global targetFPR.1; report native-final archived reference separately
calibration: same scalar fake_logit-real_logit adapter;fixed0.5 supplementary;never test calibration
